stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native support for DFlash and image input.

stories.title: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Google is integrating 'Personal Intelligence' into Gemini AI for in-car use via Android Auto and built-in systems.
The AI will access user data across various Google services (Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, etc.) to provide personalized assistance.
This feature allows users to ask context-aware questions while driving, such as checking flight status.

stories.title: SpaceX will try catching Starship and its booster for first time, Musk says
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: SpaceX plans its first attempt to fully recover Starship and its booster next month.
Successful recovery would be a historic first for an orbital launch vehicle.
The goal is to achieve full recovery of the entire orbital launch system.

stories.title: Gemini's Personal Intelligence is coming to cars
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Gemini's personal intelligence features are being integrated into automotive systems.
This signals a major shift in how large language models will interact with in-car technology.
Users are advised to review their Gemini settings in light of this new integration.

stories.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
stories.author: Yuval Atzmon
bullet_points: Introduces a novel model that directly co-generates 3D motion and video simultaneously.
Addresses a key limitation in current video generation: translating pixel-based motion into replayable 3D animation for specific assets.
The system integrates motion generation with camera tracking, allowing for realistic 3D scene replay.

stories.title: Eight Bits of Trust; eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
stories.author: hkc
bullet_points: Critical security breach involving eMudhra's Certificate Authority (CA) keys.
The keys were reportedly cracked in milliseconds, indicating a severe vulnerability.
This represents a major incident in digital trust and PKI security.

stories.title: Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
stories.author: gumby
bullet_points: Muse, an AI tool, has been reported to expose sensitive user data.
The security vulnerability involves the sharing of personal and business conversations.
This highlights critical privacy and data handling risks in generative AI services.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
The associated tags confirm its relevance to major AI frameworks like transformers and the Llama family.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
The associated tags (transformers, llama, safetensors) confirm its relevance within the modern NLP/AI ecosystem.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for local, persistent operation, enabling multi-step tasks and tool calling on user hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured significant funding, raising $88M from prominent investors including Y Combinator and 8VC.
The company boasts a substantial user base, currently serving 8.9 million developers.
The news highlights the continued growth and investment interest in open-source AI model serving platforms.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to a 90% speed increase, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Tesla and SpaceX are discussing a possible merger, Musk says
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Tesla and SpaceX are reportedly discussing a potential merger.
The discussions are being managed by special committees composed of independent directors.
Elon Musk disclosed this development during SpaceX's third-quarter earnings call.

stories.title: SpaceX says big AI growth fueled revenue jump
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: SpaceX reported a massive 161% year-over-year revenue jump in Q3, reaching $14.6 billion.
The growth is attributed to the 'Super Intelligence (SI)' segment and accelerated growth in the Connectivity division.
While the Space division incurred a $7 million operating loss, the Connectivity group generated $2.4 billion in operating income.

stories.title: PHP warns it plans to release 2 emergency patches imminently
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: A critical, unconfirmed vulnerability (PHP2Shell) is reported to allow remote code execution on PHP websites.
The PHP project team is reportedly preparing to release two emergency patches to address the threat.
This represents an immediate and high-severity security risk for any infrastructure running vulnerable PHP versions.

stories.title: Meta drops the word "train" from its commercial TOS after AI backlash
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Meta has modified its commercial Terms of Service (TOS) by removing the term 'train' in relation to AI usage.
This change follows public backlash concerning how Meta's data is used for training AI models.
Crucially, Meta has not updated its policy to incorporate respect for robots.txt directives.

stories.title: The Internet goes on high alert after discovery of 8 compromised TLS certs
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Discovery of 8 compromised TLS certificates poses a significant internet security risk.
The vulnerability stems from intermediate certificates, which allow unauthorized parties to mint web credentials.
This flaw potentially enables attackers to impersonate or compromise any Internet server.

stories.title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
stories.author: Jeroen Vanbaar
bullet_points: Introduces UniWALM, a unified model designed to integrate language, perception (video), and action for embodied robot control.
The model learns all modalities within a single shared representation, using each modality as both a conditioning signal and a supervision target.
The research investigates how joint language generation can enrich the shared representation to improve manipulation and enable memory-dependent robot behavior.

stories.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
stories.author: Yuval Atzmon
bullet_points: Introduces a novel model capable of co-generating both realistic video and corresponding 3D motion data.
Addresses a key limitation in current video generation models: the inability to translate pixel-level motion into replayable 3D animation for specific assets.
The system integrates 3D motion generation with camera registration, allowing for scene-aware animation of arbitrary rigs.

stories.title: OptionWorld: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Failures of LLMs as Long-Term Personal Assistants
stories.author: Shilong Liu
bullet_points: Introduces OptionWorld, a new benchmark specifically designed to test LLMs' capabilities as long-term personal assistants.
The benchmark simulates complex, multi-day daily-life tasks that require tracking evolving information and context.
It aims to diagnose specific failure points in current LLMs regarding task completion, information retention, and decision-making over time.

stories.title: eMudhra intermediate CA compromise
stories.author: galadran
bullet_points: eMudhra, an intermediate Certificate Authority (CA), has been compromised.
Mozilla has issued security advisories and updates to protect Firefox users from the breach.
The incident highlights critical vulnerabilities in the Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) ecosystem.

stories.title: Clef is available on Ollama's cloud
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Cloudflare's 27B multimodal decision model, Clef, is now integrated with Ollama.
Users have the option to run Clef either locally or via Ollama's cloud infrastructure.
This integration expands the capabilities of Ollama by adding a powerful, large-scale multimodal model.

stories.title: Reflection's Beam is freely available on Ollama for a limited time
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Reflection's open-weight model, Beam, is now available on the Ollama platform.
Beam is specifically designed for complex tasks such as software engineering, reasoning, and agentic workflows.
The model is offered for free for a limited promotional period via Ollama Cloud.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the use of local AI models within a cloud environment.
The integration allows AI agents to run safely on Fly.io's cloud infrastructure.
This combination addresses the need for secure, deployable AI agent solutions.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models allow for fast, typed decision-making based on text input.
The feature enables low-latency, cost-free responses providing probabilistic answers (yes/no, choices, scores).

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to leverage open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It represents a bridge between proprietary AI platforms and local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: YouTube might be testing hiding the dislike button
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: YouTube is reportedly testing a change to hide the dislike button on videos.
Evidence of this change includes user reports and screenshots showing the button moved to a submenu or absent entirely.
This feature modification suggests a potential shift in how user feedback and engagement are managed on the platform.

stories.title: Oura adds two new cardiovascular health tracking features to its smart rings
stories.author: Andrew Liszewski
bullet_points: Oura is enhancing its smart ring capabilities with new cardiovascular health tracking features.
The new features, Cardio Effort and automatic VO2 Max, aim to help users optimize their exercise routines.
The updates allow users to better gauge the long-term health impact of their workouts.

stories.title: GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery
stories.author: Ting Zhu
bullet_points: Introduces GBClaw, an agentic AI framework designed for atomistic research on grain boundaries (GBs).
Addresses the challenge of applying agentic AI to complex, domain-intensive mechanistic investigations in materials science.
Focuses on general GBs, which are prevalent in real-world polycrystalline materials but are currently understudied.

stories.title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
stories.author: Anthony Rizk
bullet_points: Introduces IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system designed for robot fleets.
Addresses the high computational, communication, and storage costs associated with preserving operational observations in large robot deployments.
Aims to reduce server-side computation by generating concise scene descriptions from continuous robot observations.

stories.title: MindView: Benchmarking Generative Multi-View Spatial Intelligence
stories.author: Jiwen Lu
bullet_points: Introduces MindView, a new benchmark for evaluating generative multi-view spatial intelligence.
Addresses the gap in language-guided generation of spatially consistent views from partial observations.
The benchmark comprises 1,500 samples across three indoor datasets and features geometry-dominant tasks.

stories.title: Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction: How far should we go?
stories.author: Xinyuan Cao
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of optimizing Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) in language model decoding.
MTP accelerates decoding by drafting multiple tokens in one pass, but the optimal draft length is context-dependent.
A key technical hurdle is that MTP requires fixing the prediction horizon upfront, unlike token-by-token autoregressive drafting.

stories.title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
stories.author: Ziran Min
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of root cause analysis in complex, distributed microservice environments.
Proposes 'Semantic Observability,' an autonomous multi-agent framework to unify disparate logs.
Aims to overcome limitations of manual log filtering and disjointed temporal correlation for SREs.

stories.title: Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems
stories.author: Alham Fikri Aji
bullet_points: Introduces DAR-MGSM, the first manually curated benchmark for mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic.
Addresses the gap in low-resource language AI by focusing on math word problems requiring multi-step reasoning.
The benchmark covers five major Arabic dialects alongside Modern Standard Arabic (MSA).

stories.title: Value-Rich, Differently Organized: Measuring Value Expression and Organization in AI-Generated Debates
stories.author: Jiamou Liu
bullet_points: Addresses a gap in current LLM evaluation by moving beyond simple argumentative quality.
Introduces a diagnostic metric framework to analyze how values are expressed and organized in AI debates.
Distinguishes between 'value expression' (range of values) and 'value organization' (distribution across turns).

stories.title: Turning TS2Vec into a Foundation Model for Time Series Classification
stories.author: Irina Rish
bullet_points: The research investigates adapting TS2Vec, a strong self-supervised method for time series classification, into a foundation model framework.
TS2Vec is noted for its compact convolutional architecture and ability to handle variable-length time series inputs without resampling.
The work addresses the current industry trend of moving towards reusable, general-purpose foundation models in the time series domain.

stories.title: Learning Adaptable Dexterous Skills via Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking
stories.author: Shubham Tulsiani
bullet_points: The research addresses limitations in current robotic learning for dexterous manipulation, where existing methods force trade-offs between generalization and naturalness.
The paper introduces 'AdaDex,' a method designed to learn adaptable dexterous skills by incorporating human prior knowledge into reinforcement learning.
The work aims to overcome issues where pure goal-reaching RL yields unnatural strategies, and motion tracking lacks the ability to adapt beyond the initial demonstration.

stories.title: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
stories.author: Anima Anandkumar
bullet_points: Introduces 'Planning Under Noise' (PUN), a neural operator designed for planning under uncertain control execution noise.
PUN learns noise-aware value fields, enabling planning in unseen and diverse geometric environments.
Addresses challenges in stochastic optimal control by refining boundary condition specification and efficient gradient computation.

stories.title: Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction: How far should we go?
stories.author: Xinyuan Cao
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of optimizing Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) in language model decoding.
MTP accelerates decoding by drafting multiple tokens simultaneously, but the optimal prediction horizon is context-dependent.
A key technical hurdle is that MTP requires fixing the draft horizon upfront, unlike token-by-token autoregressive drafting.

stories.title: Turning TS2Vec into a Foundation Model for Time Series Classification
stories.author: Irina Rish
bullet_points: The paper proposes adapting TS2Vec, a strong self-supervised method for time series classification, into a foundation model paradigm.
TS2Vec's key advantage is its compact convolutional architecture that handles variable-length temporal inputs without resampling.
The research addresses the industry shift towards reusable foundation models by leveraging TS2Vec's inherent properties.

stories.title: Neural Implicit Energy Optimization for LiDAR Mapping
stories.author: Aniket Bera
bullet_points: The research addresses artifacts (jitter/noise) in geometry recovered from sparse LiDAR data using neural implicit representations.
It proposes framing neural LiDAR mapping as an optimization problem over energy functionals, similar to classical geometric optimization.
The goal is to leverage energy minimization principles to achieve smoother and more accurate surface reconstruction from noisy inputs.

stories.title: PaPi: Parallel Picard-Duhamel Integration for Fast Neuro-Spectral Architectures
stories.author: Daniel Yukimura
bullet_points: Introduces PaPi, a new integration scheme designed to accelerate Neuro-Spectral Architectures (NeuSA).
PaPi addresses the computational bottleneck in NeuSA by enabling time-parallel inference, overcoming limitations of sequential Runge-Kutta methods.
The work focuses on improving the efficiency of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) used for solving time-dependent Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) in the frequency domain.

stories.title: Two $\operatorname{ReLU}$ Layers is All You Need
stories.author: Amir Yehudayoff
bullet_points: The research proves that any network built with ReLU activation functions can be perfectly replicated by a network containing only two hidden layers.
Two distinct mathematical proofs are presented: one utilizing homological algebra and another employing a direct combinatorial approach.
This result offers theoretical insight into the expressive power and architectural complexity required for ReLU-based neural networks.

stories.title: NarraSpace: Multimodal Scene-Grounded Evidence for Picture-Description Dementia Classification
stories.author: Satoshi Nakamura
bullet_points: NarraSpace is a new multimodal approach designed to improve Picture-Description Dementia classification.
It links textual utterances and speech timing to specific named elements within a shared visual scene.
The model uses narrative-spatial descriptors and a frozen language model to contrast evidence from Alzheimer's patients versus healthy controls.

stories.title: Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems
stories.author: Alham Fikri Aji
bullet_points: Introduces DAR-MGSM, the first manually curated benchmark for mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic.
Addresses the gap in evaluating mathematical reasoning for low-resource languages, specifically Dialectal Arabic.
The benchmark covers five major Arabic dialects plus Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) using multi-step math word problems.

stories.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
stories.author: Yu Wang
bullet_points: KV cache I/O and storage are becoming the primary bottleneck for complex LLM agent tasks with long observation/action trajectories.
Existing context engineering methods (trimming/summarizing) are insufficient because modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates cached states.
The research focuses on cache engineering to manage active cache growth, especially when trajectories exceed the LLM's maximum context length.

stories.title: Large Flow Language Models
stories.author: Jinwoo Kim
bullet_points: Introduces Lafa, a new Large Flow Language Model designed for fast and high-performing text generation.
Addresses the challenge of scaling continuous flow models to the billion-parameter level, a less established area compared to discrete diffusion models.
Lafa utilizes a blockwise flow model architecture with causal attention on the prefix and asynchronous flow internally.

stories.title: Binary Discrete Diffusion: Candidate-Set Diffusion for Logic and Planning Tasks
stories.author: Aran Raoufi
bullet_points: Introduces Binary Discrete Diffusion models for handling categorical data like text.
These models offer advanced capabilities such as any-order generation, self-correction, and in-filling.
They show promise for complex tasks like reasoning, planning, and constrained generation (e.g., coding/math), addressing limitations in traditional masked diffusion.

stories.title: BitMTP: When Multi-Token Prediction Meets Low-Bit Large Language Models
stories.author: Lei Zhang
bullet_points: The paper addresses the efficiency challenge in deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) by combining two techniques: ultra-low-bit backbones and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP).
Low-bit backbones reduce resource consumption (storage, memory traffic, execution cost) for LLMs.
MTP accelerates decoding by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel, but the paper notes challenges in directly combining MTP with low-bit methods due to training discrepancies.

stories.title: Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder
stories.author: Zhouhan Lin
bullet_points: Introduces the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop) to improve upon standard Looped Transformers.
AsymLoop separates the single-pass context encoding from the recurrent state refinement process.
This architectural change aims to better manage the roles within iterative decoding while maintaining computational efficiency.

stories.title: Upcoming critical PHP security release (CVE-2026-109618 / -109619)
stories.author: xd
bullet_points: A critical security release is upcoming for PHP, referencing CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.
The advisory originates from the European Union's Certificate Authority (cert.europa.eu).
The news is being discussed on Hacker News, indicating relevance to the developer community.

stories.title: Stress-Testing Gemini 4 Argon: Building a 3D Flutter Kart Game in 15 Prompts with Zero Assets
stories.author: leehack
bullet_points: The article explores using frontier AI models (like Gemini 4 Argon) for complex, creative coding tasks.
It demonstrates building a non-standard application (a 3D Flutter Kart Game) using minimal prompts and no pre-existing assets.
The piece highlights a gap in current AI coding benchmarks, which often focus only on standard CRUD applications.

stories.title: MCP vs function calling: which one your AI agent actually needs (2026)
stories.author: joancomadran
bullet_points: The article compares two concepts in AI agent development: MCP and function calling.
It clarifies that MCP and function calling are complementary, not rivals, with distinct roles (tool requesting vs. tool shipping).
The content promises a detailed analysis including a comparison table, spec updates, and production code examples.
